mechanism:
Inspect the current world, schedule, scene tree, and imposed no-go zone to find the 7 still-required navigation goals whose reachability was lost because of the zone. Edit the scene tree so each affected goal has a reachable, zone-compliant navigation destination. This may relocate the relevant staging or deposition geometry, adjust enclosing sub-assembly transforms, or translate a larger portion of the unfinished build; the implementation method is open. All dependent scene transforms must remain consistent so that DepositCargo and LiftIntoPlace operations still produce the assembly represented by the schedule.

The required postcondition is that the no-go zone remains unchanged and enforced, while every one of the 7 directly blocked required navigation goals has a legal route for an RVO-driven navigating agent and the downstream 176 nodes are no longer frozen by those route losses. The schedule’s precedence edges are not weakened, and the tool does not assign robots, solve the MILP, move cargo through the zone, or treat exclusion enforcement gaps as routes.

The tool consumes no depot spare. Any physical repositioning required to make the edited scene geometry true consumes simulated time and energy through ordinary legal motion. Preconditions are that a geometrically valid reachable placement exists that preserves the required assembly relationships. The scene-tree edit can be undone before work uses the new placements; after cargo has been deposited or assembly has proceeded at those placements, reversal requires corresponding lawful physical relocation and is not a metadata-only undo.
impl_code:
function relocate_blocked_navigation_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = [first(zone) for zone in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && error("no active restriction zone is available to diagnose")

    before = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    if before.n_blocked > 0 || before.n_downstream > 0 || before.project_blocked
        restaged = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        after = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)

        if after.n_blocked > 0 || after.n_downstream > 0 || after.project_blocked
            translated = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
            final_report = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
            if final_report.n_blocked > 0 || final_report.n_downstream > 0 || final_report.project_blocked
                error("scene relocation failed: restaging=$(restaged.status), translation=$(translated.status), residual=$(final_report.n_blocked)")
            end
        end
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end
